theme_and_archetype.description: Premium clinical app for patients with end-stage renal disease. The interface focuses on clarity, medical-grade trust, and approachability. Uses a muted, warm clinical palette instead of cold 'tech' colors.

typography.instructions: Use Outfit for all headings and major numbers (like vital readings). Use IBM Plex Sans for general body text, form labels, and tables. Avoid standard Arial/Inter to maintain a premium feel. Use larger base fonts (16-18px minimum) to ensure readability for the older demographic (30-70 years).

colors.instructions: Apply these colors to Tailwind configuration. Avoid pure black/white where possible, leaning into the soft off-white background (#F7F7F6) and charcoal text (#1A1C1A). Vitals charts should use distinct, accessible colors that fit this earthy palette.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. The target demographic requires clear, large touch targets (minimum 44x44px) and ample breathing room between elements to reduce cognitive load.
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento Grid Protocol. Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 or md:grid-cols-3 for dashboard widgets. Cards should have p-6 or p-8 internal padding.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-xl for cards and panels. rounded-lg for buttons and inputs.
layout_and_spacing.shadows: Very soft, ambient shadows. shadow-sm for default cards, shadow-md on hover. Avoid harsh dark shadows.

components.buttons: Large, accessible touch targets (min-h-[48px]). Primary buttons use bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary-hover. Use subtle transition-all duration-200.
components.cards: Solid white backgrounds (bg-card) with subtle 1px border (border-border). No glassmorphism. Flat solid surfaces are critical for health apps to prevent visual refraction of data.
components.forms: Use Shadcn UI Input, Label, Select. Inputs should be tall (h-12) with text-base for easy tapping and reading.
components.charts: Use Recharts. Line charts for vitals trends. Keep charts minimal: hide excessive grid lines, use smooth curves (type='monotone'), and ensure data points have tooltips.
components.navigation: Sticky top header with a solid background and bottom border. Include app logo, patient name, and logout button. Mobile should use a simple bottom nav or hamburger menu.

login.layout: Centered card layout. Minimalist form. MR ID input (text or number), Password input.
login.visuals: Use the abstract clean medical background image as a subtle page background behind the centered white login card.

dashboard.layout: Greeting header. Quick-entry bento grid for today's vitals (BP, Weight, Glucose, Urine Output). Adherence checklist for daily medication.
dashboard.widgets: Vitals entry cards should have large input fields and clear 'Save' buttons. Medication list should use Shadcn Checkbox with strikethrough effect on check.

vitals_history.layout: Tabs to switch between 'List View' and 'Trends (Graphs)'.
vitals_history.features: List view uses a clean table or stacked cards showing date, vital type, and value with edit/delete actions. Trends view uses Recharts line graphs with date on X-axis and values on Y-axis.

prescriptions.layout: Vertical list or grid of prescription cards.
prescriptions.features: Each card shows doctor name, date, medication list, dosage, and frequency. Read-only view.

profile.features: Displays MR ID, Father Name, Age, DOB, and Diagnosis in a clear key-value list (Shadcn description list or grid).

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Buttons lift slightly (-translate-y-0.5) and shadows deepen. Interactive list items highlight background color on hover.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out for buttons, links, and cards.
motion_and_interactions.loading: Use subtle pulse animations on skeleton loaders instead of spinning wheels where possible.

icons.usage: Use icons to support text labels, not replace them. E.g., a heart icon for BP, a scale for weight, a droplet for glucose/urine.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text, especially muted text, meets WCAG AA 4.5:1 against the background.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs) MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='vital-bp-input').

login_background.description: Abstract, flowing white lines on a soft background. Use on the login screen to provide a premium clinical feel without being distracting.

instructions_to_main_agent: Update tailwind.config.js with the provided colors in the colors.tailwind_vars section.
Install and configure Outfit and IBM Plex Sans fonts via Google Fonts in index.html.
Ensure the app layout handles a top navigation bar (Header) present on all authenticated pages.
Use Recharts for the Vitals History page graphs. Keep them clean, removing unnecessary grid lines.
Implement the Quick Entry dashboard for vitals using Shadcn components (Input, Button, Card).
Add 'data-testid' to every form input, submit button, and actionable item.
Do NOT implement dark mode. The application must remain light-themed to maintain the clean clinical aesthetic.
For the Medication Checklist, ensure checked items have a visual change (e.g., text-muted-foreground and line-through).
